name: In-game Submarine Designer - Experimental
author: Local RTW3 Mod Tools
description: Extends the original Ship design screen: select SS - Submarine class under Ship type, or use F11 with a loaded campaign. Reuses native class-name, displacement, surfaced-speed, tab and finish controls. Saves submarine blueprints separately, never as surface ships. Matching new native boats can receive class labels, availability and accuracy through Save and order. Other component/performance fields remain estimates; native costs, build times, weapons and tactical movement are unchanged. Game restart required to update or unload.
